band_path: proven disjoint by caption lane t1-pm-13; this lane leaves band placement byte-identical (repo test: band captions ignore toast windows)

choice.detection_rejected: render-time bottom-band pixel detection misfires under camera motion: on the overlay path the camera moves, so the bottom band changes every move with no toast present; a still-band/fade carve-out cannot separate toast pixels from reframed footage without a source-space model. Stated, not built.
choice.planner_windows_chosen: take.json carries toast windows in video-relative seconds (TakeMeta.toasts, validated like blur/spotlight); the take producer observes the genuine event per frame instead of hardcoding a timestamp.
choice.up_not_wait: a toast-overlapping overlay caption moves to the established top slot (the widePhone top-text lane) for its whole hold; waiting would shift caption timing and reading time, and top placement is already a product behavior, not a new invention.

limitations: Real desktop takes have no toast producer yet: nothing observes OS toasts into take.json, so the avoidance only engages where windows are supplied. Stated, not faked.
The proof beat is a static full-screen hold; camera moves during a toast window are covered by repo tests only insofar as placement is camera-independent (top slot).
